"9488c98e-2c06-5b39-b9eb-8420048bbf36" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{2}{|2 x|\sqrt{4 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|2 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "9488c98e-2c06-5b39-b9eb-8420048bbf36" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|2 x|>1$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $2\cdot \frac{1}{2}=1$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{2}{|2 x|\sqrt{4 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(2 x \right)}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "9488c98e-2c06-5b39-b9eb-8420048bbf36" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "9488c98e-2c06-5b39-b9eb-8420048bbf36" :question/answer-fields $$
\int \frac{4}{|3 x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|3 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "4d9def4d-ec1c-5e4e-89a1-371b4cabc16f" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(3)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|3 x|>1$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{3}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $4\cdot \frac{1}{3}=\frac{4}{3}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{|3 x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{4}{3}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
\frac{4}{3}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{4}{3}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{4}{3}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(3 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "4d9def4d-ec1c-5e4e-89a1-371b4cabc16f" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "4d9def4d-ec1c-5e4e-89a1-371b4cabc16f" :question/answer-fields $$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.

$$
\frac{1}{2}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{1}{2}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{1}{2}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(4 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "1caba02f-6c79-5afe-bb8d-c39aa859627c" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "1caba02f-6c79-5afe-bb8d-c39aa859627c" :question/answer-fields "37abf18f-59b7-5062-b961-a51a11c28165" :question/id #uuid "37abf18f-59b7-5062-b961-a51a11c28165"] [:db/add "37abf18f-59b7-5062-b961-a51a11c28165" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{2}{|x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|5 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "37abf18f-59b7-5062-b961-a51a11c28165" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=5 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(5)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|5 x|>1$.

Because $5>0$, $|u|=5|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/5$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $10\cdot \frac{1}{5}=2$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{2}{|x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=2\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
2\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(5 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "37abf18f-59b7-5062-b961-a51a11c28165" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "37abf18f-59b7-5062-b961-a51a11c28165" :question/answer-fields $$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=4\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$

$$

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$

$$

$$

"1caba02f-6c79-5afe-bb8d-c39aa859627c" :question/id #uuid "1caba02f-6c79-5afe-bb8d-c39aa859627c"] [:db/add "1caba02f-6c79-5afe-bb8d-c39aa859627c" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{2}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|4 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "1caba02f-6c79-5afe-bb8d-c39aa859627c" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|4 x|>1$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $2\cdot \frac{1}{4}=\frac{1}{2}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{2}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{2}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
\frac{1}{2}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{1}{2}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{1}{2}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(4 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "1caba02f-6c79-5afe-bb8d-c39aa859627c" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "1caba02f-6c79-5afe-bb8d-c39aa859627c" :question/answer-fields Because $4>0$, $|u|=4|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/4$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $16\cdot \frac{1}{4}=4$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=4\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

$$

$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{3}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $2\cdot \frac{1}{3}=\frac{2}{3}$.

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.

$$
\frac{2}{3}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{2}{3}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

["37abf18f-59b7-5062-b961-a51a11c28165" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{2}{|x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|5 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] ["37abf18f-59b7-5062-b961-a51a11c28165" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=5 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(5)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|5 x|>1$.

Because $5>0$, $|u|=5|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/5$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $10\cdot \frac{1}{5}=2$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{2}{|x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=2\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
2\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(5 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] ["37abf18f-59b7-5062-b961-a51a11c28165" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] ["37abf18f-59b7-5062-b961-a51a11c28165" :question/answer-fields "30dc7a84-162e-59b5-a42f-53d385ff7811"] ["c09037c3-7c78-521a-be7b-f6e802c6d11b" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{3}{|x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|5 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] ["c09037c3-7c78-521a-be7b-f6e802c6d11b" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=5 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(5)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|5 x|>1$.

Because $5>0$, $|u|=5|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/5$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $15\cdot \frac{1}{5}=3$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3}{|x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=3\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
3\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=3\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
3\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(5 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] ["c09037c3-7c78-521a-be7b-f6e802c6d11b" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] ["c09037c3-7c78-521a-be7b-f6e802c6d11b" :question/answer-fields "5c9b6698-5b58-5d1f-a7ae-37162a7fec26"]
